chain.title: A Garden with a Purpose
chain.desc: Keep the Lexica Botania close. Its entries explain flower behavior, mana handling and multiblock structures; use the diagrams when you reach a new machine or ritual.

chain.title: Colours in the Grass
chain.desc: Gather Mystical Flowers and turn them into petals. Petal colours matter to flower recipes, so store different colours separately while you build your first garden.

chain.title: The First Living Machine
chain.desc: Fill the Petal Apothecary with water, add the ingredients for a flower recipe and finish it with the required seed. Start with a Pure Daisy to unlock your construction materials.

chain.title: Patient Alchemy
chain.desc: Plant a Pure Daisy and place the appropriate blocks around it. Allow the transformation to finish before harvesting Livingwood and Livingrock; the Lexica shows the supported inputs.

chain.title: A Living Framework
chain.desc: Transform suitable logs beside the Pure Daisy. Livingwood supports many early Botania components, including the parts you need to direct mana.

chain.title: Stone for the Garden
chain.desc: Transform Stone beside the Pure Daisy to obtain Livingrock. Keep a supply for the Mana Pool and Runic Altar instead of rebuilding the transformation area each time.

chain.title: Tell the Mana Where to Go
chain.desc: Use the Wand of the Forest to inspect mana devices and configure their bindings. It is your main tool for connecting flowers, spreaders and pools.

chain.title: A Reservoir for Later
chain.desc: Aim a Mana Spreader at the pool and begin storing mana. The same pool can also infuse supported items; check its available mana before starting an expensive recipe.

chain.title: Give Mana a Direction
chain.desc: Place a Mana Spreader near your generating flower and bind it toward a Mana Pool with the Wand. Keep its firing path clear and confirm the pool receives the bursts.

chain.title: Feed the Fire
chain.desc: Drop a suitable fuel near the Endoflame and bind it to a nearby Mana Spreader. Watch the pool fill before automating fuel delivery, so you know the whole mana path works.

chain.title: A Garden That Feeds Itself
chain.desc: Use the Open Crate to drop items into the world. Combine controlled fuel delivery with your Endoflame setup so the garden can keep producing while you work elsewhere.

chain.title: The First Mana Metal
chain.desc: Drop Iron into a Mana Pool with enough mana for the infusion recipe. Manasteel leads to tools, equipment and the first runes.

chain.title: A Pearl, Changed
chain.desc: Infuse an Ender Pearl in the Mana Pool. Save the result for recipes such as runes and advanced mana components.

chain.title: Stored Potential
chain.desc: Infuse a Diamond in the Mana Pool. You will need Mana Diamonds for several advanced devices and for the Terrasteel process.

chain.title: A New Kind of Crafting
chain.desc: Place the recipe ingredients on the Runic Altar and feed it mana from a spreader. When the altar is ready, finish the craft with Livingrock and the Wand as shown in the Lexica.

chain.title: Focus the Enchantment
chain.desc: Place Mana Pylons near an enchanting table to strengthen its setup. Keep additional pylons for the upgrades used by later structures.

chain.title: Runes of Water
chain.desc: Complete the Water Rune recipe on the Runic Altar. Keep runes organized: later flowers and machines combine several different rune types.

chain.title: Runes of Fire
chain.desc: Complete the Fire Rune recipe on the Runic Altar. Preparing the elemental runes in parallel makes the next machine easier to assemble.

chain.title: Runes of Earth
chain.desc: Complete the Earth Rune recipe on the Runic Altar. Store it with the other elemental runes for the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate.

chain.title: Runes of Air
chain.desc: Complete the Air Rune recipe on the Runic Altar. This is another branch of the rune workshop you will draw on for advanced Botania crafting.

chain.title: A Rune of Pure Mana
chain.desc: Complete the Mana Rune recipe on the Runic Altar. Bring this and the elemental runes together for the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate.

chain.title: Build the Terrasteel Platform
chain.desc: Use the Lexica’s multiblock diagram to build the platform beneath the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate. The placed structure and a sufficient mana supply are both required before you can produce Terrasteel.

chain.title: Mana Across the Gap
chain.desc: Place Sparks on supported mana devices to transfer mana between them. Use the Lexica to set up a Spark connection from a pool to the Terrasteel plate.

chain.title: A Garden Becomes an Industry
chain.desc: Supply the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate with the Terrasteel ingredients and enough mana to finish the process. Have the mana ready before starting so the dropped ingredients can finish transforming.

chain.title: A Blade for the Trials
chain.desc: Craft the Terra Blade and keep a mana supply with you to use its abilities. Test the weapon before taking it into a major fight.

chain.title: Prepare the Gateway
chain.desc: Prepare the Natura Pylons for the Elven Gateway. Follow the Lexica’s layout for the pylons and their mana pools before trying to open the portal.

chain.title: Trade Beyond the Garden
chain.desc: Build the Elven Gateway using the Lexica’s structure preview, then activate it with the Wand. The gateway trades items with Alfheim; it is not a portal you walk through.

chain.title: An Elven Exchange
chain.desc: Trade through the open Elven Gateway to obtain Elementium. The metal expands your equipment and supplies components for the next ritual.

chain.title: A Little Elven Magic
chain.desc: Obtain Pixie Dust through an Elven Gateway trade. Set some aside for the Gaia Pylons rather than spending the entire first batch.

chain.title: Mark the Arena
chain.desc: Build Gaia Pylons and arrange the ritual area around an active Beacon exactly as the Lexica shows. Clear the arena and prepare your equipment before summoning the Guardian.

chain.title: The Garden’s First Trial
chain.desc: Prepare the Ritual of Gaia using the Lexica, then summon and defeat the Gaia Guardian. Bring reliable equipment and healing; building the ritual is only the preparation for this quest.

chain.title: Proof of the Trial
chain.desc: Collect Gaia Spirits from the Guardian encounter. They unlock powerful equipment and the materials for a second, harder ritual.

chain.title: Prepare the Greater Trial
chain.desc: Combine Gaia Spirits with Terrasteel for a Gaia Spirit Ingot. This is the offering for the harder Ritual of Gaia; prepare the arena and your supplies before using it.

chain.title: Fate Has a Reward
chain.desc: Complete the stronger Gaia encounter and collect a Dice of Fate. Use it to receive a relic reward, then consult its Lexica entry to learn what it does.

chain.title: Treasury of the King
chain.desc: Obtain the Key of the King’s Law from the relic rewards. Try its summoned weapons in a safe area and learn the charge-and-release timing before relying on it in combat.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.
